8. Direct warnings about major historical events

threads.name: Removed name in death notices
setup: someone had cut a narrow strip from every article
threads.payoff: No identity or actor proved. Planned newspaper-photograph chapter may address it, but no manuscript is present.
threads.test: Track which original, copy, and newspaper contains each cut; a missing name alone does not identify Tomas.

threads.name: Electrical-fault report versus wiring diagrams
setup: maintenance diagrams showed no active wiring in that wall
threads.payoff: No arson proof yet; the final scratch repeats the corridor location.
threads.test: Corroborate diagrams' dates and the report's authority before interpreting deliberate fire.

threads.name: Who scratched TOMAS and the fire warning?
threads.payoff: Warning discovered at ending; author, date, and relation to Tomas remain unknown.
threads.test: Compare Daniel's first photograph and current glass before assigning a time-loop author.

threads.name: Token and opening trigger
setup: The station answered with a click.
threads.payoff: Opening follows token handling, but midnight is a confounder; token remains on floor at last explicit mention.
threads.test: Record possession and whether recurrence depends on the token; do not assume it is a magic key.

threads.name: Two clocks and prior stoppage
setup: That clock has been broken for two years.
threads.payoff: Cafe clock runs 12:00-12:07; station clock stays at 12:07. No connection or origin explained.
threads.test: Separate station and cafe clocks in the location plan and chronological ledger.

threads.name: Dangerous wrist touch versus safe window touch
threads.payoff: Later fingertips meet through the window without pain. Initial tray contact is brief and also causes no reported pain.
threads.test: Distinguish shared-object contact, unstable counter overlap, and window contact before defining a universal rule.

threads.name: Forward aging and fresh bread
setup: By the time Daniel lifted it, the roll was forty years old.
threads.payoff: Proof of temporal separation; better bread is a romantic promise, not a demonstrated solution to aging.
threads.test: Future pastry scene must change knowledge or stakes, not merely repeat this test.

threads.name: The first archival sleeve
threads.state: Local emotional payoff; future custody open
threads.payoff: Tomas answers Then I am real too and pockets the sleeve. It is not the later torn notebook reply.
threads.test: Track material, writing, custody, and aging separately for both pieces of paper.

threads.name: Returned notebook page and smoke stain
setup: DO NOT TELL ANYONE ABOUT ME.
threads.payoff: Reply confirms responsive contact and a promise to return; smoke stain does not independently prove the fire's date or Tomas's death.
threads.test: Establish when Tomas writes and how the paper is delivered after closure.

threads.name: Tomorrow's meeting
threads.payoff: No second meeting in the available manuscript.
threads.test: Chapter 2 must deliver or purposefully complicate the promise with visible consequences.

threads.name: The broker and undrunk coffee
setup: A broker in a white suit bought coffee and did not drink it.
threads.payoff: Tomas names Arturo; no criminal act witnessed in Chapter 1. Page 11 uses unsupported Rafael identity.
threads.test: Tie inquiry to evidence and preserve alternative explanations until corroboration.

threads.name: Failed southbound signal and delayed service
threads.payoff: Earlier announcement mentions delay; notes later connect tampered signals to Ernesto. No causal chain yet.
threads.test: Preserve clue visibility in adaptation and differentiate ordinary failure from sabotage.

threads.name: Lilia's hidden object and Tomas's notebook
threads.payoff: No hiding scene, recovered object, or proved dangerous notebook contents.
threads.test: Decide what each knows, why it threatens someone, and who controls the object.

threads.name: Compromised witnesses
threads.payoff: Benjamin's statement and Ernesto's recollections are not dramatized.
threads.test: Give each witness an independent incentive, cost, and observable contradiction.

threads.name: Demolition and the present-day archive
setup: A plastic banner outside announced luxury residences coming soon
threads.payoff: No exact demolition date, present antagonist identity, or archive-change observation in prose.
threads.test: Use the present to change stakes between meetings; do not assume Arturo still controls redevelopment in 2026.

threads.name: Warnings consume time
threads.state: Author rule and future promise only
setup: 8. Direct warnings about major historical events
threads.payoff: Not yet observed; first meeting reaches 12:07.
threads.test: Establish baseline and repeated effects without explaining away every ordinary flicker as a warning penalty.

threads.name: Rescue erases relationship or memory
setup: If Tomas survives by changing the past too strongly
threads.payoff: No outcome selected in the files; no guaranteed happy or tragic ending.
threads.test: Make the eventual choice jointly meaningful and preserve some consequence of earned intimacy.

threads.name: Cash drawer and archive containers
setup: one locked station cash drawer nobody had found a key for
threads.payoff: No subsequent mention. Could remain texture; not every described object requires a twist.
threads.test: Promote to a mystery prop only if it materially affects the approved arc; otherwise avoid repetitive emphasis.

timeline.unknown: Country and exact year are not specified.

evidence: That clock has been broken for two years.
timeline.unknown: Exact date and cause; do not turn an approximate inference into canon.

timeline.time: Three weeks before station visit, approximate
timeline.event: Daniel inventories the railway archive and identifies altered records.
evidence: By the third week, he agreed with her.
timeline.unknown: Accession date, demolition date, and complete investigation chronology.

timeline.event: Daniel is inside the station with permits and flashlight.
timeline.unknown: Reason for this hour and elapsed inspection duration until midnight.

timeline.event: Token handling precedes cafe clock reset; first encounter, shared tray, and names.
timeline.unknown: Daniel's date; token causality; precise mapping of the two nights.

timeline.event: Tomas reports a two-year-broken clock; identity and name-scratch exchange follows.
timeline.unknown: The station clock is a separate object; their causal relationship is unspecified.

timeline.event: Counter instability, painful wrist catch, window opening, and forward-aging pastry.
timeline.unknown: Mechanism behind the new stable exchange point.

timeline.event: Daniel sends the archival sleeve; Tomas pockets it after reciprocal affirmation.
timeline.unknown: What backward adaptation later does to that sleeve.

timeline.event: Flashlight falls; Lilia calls from kitchen; Daniel attends to Tomas.
timeline.unknown: What Lilia can perceive of Daniel or the time boundary.

timeline.event: Two minutes remain; Tomas reports broker and signal failure.
timeline.unknown: Why Daniel prioritizes the broker over the other anomalies.

timeline.event: Closing lights, tomorrow promise, notebook instruction, safe fingertip touch.
timeline.unknown: When Tomas writes the reply between receipt and apparent return.

timeline.event: Cafe closes; aged reply arrives; dust reveals warning; station clock still stopped.
evidence: For several seconds he did not move.
timeline.unknown: Delivery mechanism and whether the warning existed in Daniel's original photo.

timeline.time: Stormy night in 1986, exact date unavailable
timeline.event: Station fire is recorded as electrical accident; Tomas's death is in the premise.
evidence: Officially an electrical accident on a stormy night in 1986.
timeline.unknown: Relationship to the first meeting, actual victims, arson mechanism, escape routes, and evidence tampering.

cast.name: Daniel Soriano
cast.status: On-page protagonist; age 36 is reference fact
cast.want: Opening: understand altered fire records and the encounter. Romance/rescue becomes planned longer-term want.
cast.need: Interpretation: accept uncertainty and Tomas's agency without reducing him to preservable evidence.
cast.fear: Immediate connection loss; future memory erasure is author intent, not learned in Chapter 1.
cast.flaw: Possible overcontrol and emotional avoidance; not an approved diagnosis.
cast.agency: Investigates, documents, catches tray, sends proof, requests next meeting.
cast.voice: Literal professional corrections, dry institutional humor, brief replies under pressure.
cast.relations: Tomas: stranger to reciprocal recognition and promised return. Maribel: supervisor, mentioned in background.
cast.guardrail: No invented dead lover, family tragedy, or confirmed foreknowledge.
evidence: because his mind had chosen collapse by etiquette

cast.name: Tomas Rivera
cast.status: On-page romantic lead; age 28 is reference fact
cast.want: Immediate: understand visitor, share hospitality, exchange proof, meet again. Independent long-term goal unspecified.
cast.need: Interpretation: be heard beyond the expectation that he remain cheerful; retain agency in any rescue.
cast.fear: Shown alarm at aging and closure; documented-death countdown is a future premise.
cast.flaw: Cheer may conceal needs, but manipulation or naivety is not demonstrated.
cast.agency: Catches tray and wrist, offers pastry, initiates return test, supplies observations, chooses tomorrow.
cast.voice: Teasing hospitality, concrete cafe metaphors, jokes giving way to short vulnerable statements.
cast.relations: Daniel: mutual curiosity and tenderness, not an established couple. Lilia: chosen aunt/employer.
cast.guardrail: Do not treat him as passive cargo or confuse youthful warmth with being a minor.

cast.name: Maribel Santos
cast.status: Named in narrated archive background; age 44 in reference
cast.want: Assign and protect meaningful archive work; later access and changing records are planned.
cast.flaw: No demonstrated flaw; skepticism can be useful rather than obstruction.
cast.voice: One reported phrase, box of worms; broader dry voice is only reference intent.
cast.relations: Daniel's supervisor/ally. Avoid inventing knowledge of his meetings.
cast.guardrail: Her own archival objective should matter before she becomes an exposition source.
evidence: called it a box of worms and assigned Daniel

cast.name: Lilia Ramos
cast.status: Off-panel voice in prose; full name and age 53 in reference
cast.want: Run the cafe; care for Tomas; hidden-object function is provisional.
cast.agency: Interrupts the exchange as a working cafe owner; no evidence she sees Daniel.
cast.relations: Chosen aunt, explicitly not blood relative; Inez in Page 10 is unresolved substitution.
cast.guardrail: Preserve chosen-family meaning and give later secret-keeping a motive.
evidence: My aunt. Not by blood. By volume.

cast.name: Arturo Salcedo
cast.status: Named in Tomas's report; age 41 in reference
cast.want: Reference: land/redevelopment interests; precise evidence and arson motive unproved.
cast.fear: Inferred exposure of meetings is a planning possibility, not a fact.
cast.flaw: Reference: belief in erasing poor witnesses; no direct on-page conduct proves crime.
cast.agency: Reported visits, coffee purchase; arson is alleged/planned.
cast.voice: No on-page speech. Polite menace is reference intent only.
cast.relations: Tomas observes him; relation to present redevelopment unspecified.
cast.guardrail: Rafael Aragon is a conflicting source label, not an established alias; avoid declaring guilt early.
evidence: He has been visiting the station offices all month.

cast.name: Benjamin Manalo
cast.want: Do right while surviving power, per reference.
cast.flaw: Survival through selective witnessing, per reference.
cast.voice: No dialogue sample; tired discipline is a proposed voice constraint.
cast.relations: Possible ally/compromised witness; detailed ties unknown.
cast.guardrail: Do not assign actions on fire night beyond supplied notes.
evidence: He wants to do the right thing but has survived

cast.name: Ernesto Galang
cast.status: Reference only; age 72 in 2026 and 32 in 1986
cast.want: Unspecified beyond evasiveness and attachment to machines.
cast.flaw: Avoidance described, not tested in scene.
cast.agency: Planned bridge to signals and locked corridor.
cast.voice: No dialogue sample; gruff evasiveness only reference intent.
cast.relations: Survivor and mechanic; who changed his memory is unknown.
cast.guardrail: Do not confuse an unreliable witness with a proven supernatural memory alteration.
